readOnly: Only the owner and admins can change these settings.
revisionConflict: Someone else saved changes in the meantime. Your edits are still here.

company.title: Company details
company.description: How your company appears to trading partners and on new orders. Orders already placed keep the details they were placed with.
company.defaultLanguageHint: Default for your team's app and emails. Each person can choose their own.
company.staffRestricted: Only owners and admins submit and cancel orders
company.staffRestrictedHint: Staff can still prepare carts and drafts for an owner or admin to submit.
company.partnerContactHint: Connected partners see this contact. Manage contacts under Contacts.
company.identityHint: Country, registration and tax numbers can't be changed here. Contact Narudžbine support to correct a mistake.

closure.title: Close the organization
closure.description: Closing ends trading with every partner, signs everyone out and can't be undone. Order history is kept. All orders must be finished first.
closure.confirmDescription: Everyone in your team loses access and all partners are disconnected. There's no way to reopen it.
closure.reasonHint: Kept privately in the audit record; partners only see that the organization closed.

contacts.title: Business contacts
contacts.description: People or desks partners can reach. Choose which one is shared on the Company page.
contacts.label: Label
contacts.emptyHint: Add a contact to share it with your trading partners.
contacts.archiveHint: Archiving a shared contact stops sharing it.

locations.vendorDescription: Warehouses and sites you ship from.
locations.buyerDescription: Where your orders are delivered. Orders keep the address they were placed with.
locations.name: Name
locations.instructionsHint: Optional, e.g. gate code or receiving hours.
locations.emptyHint: Add the first one to get started.
locations.archiveDescription: It disappears from pickers and stops being anyone's home location. Past orders keep its address. You can restore it later.

team.name: Name
team.deactivateDescription: They're signed out everywhere and can't log in. Their past work stays. You can reactivate them later; they return as staff.
team.rolesNote: Owners manage everything; admins manage the company and staff; staff work with the catalogue and orders. Role changes sign the person out.
team.inviteDescription: They'll get an email to create their login in {org}.
team.invitationsDescription: Member invitations are valid for 7 days. An email that failed can be resent.

transfer.title: Ownership
transfer.description: There's always exactly one owner. Ownership moves only when the chosen member accepts.
transfer.offerDescription: When {name} accepts, they become the owner and you become an admin. You'll both be signed out. The offer expires in 7 days.
transfer.pendingRecipient: You've been offered ownership of {org}. It expires {date}.
transfer.referenceHint: Share this reference with the recipient if they can't see the offer here.
transfer.acceptedDescription: Everyone involved was signed out. Log in again to continue.
transfer.referenceInvalid: Enter the reference exactly as you received it
transfer.notFound: No offer for you with that reference.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.description: Changes made by people in your organization and shared trading events. Sign-in and security events aren't listed.
audit.staffNote: Only the owner and admins can see the activity log.

privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.description: Ask for a copy of your organization's data (JSON) or for personal data to be removed. Requests are reviewed by the Narudžbine team; nothing changes until then.
privacy.reasonHint: Tell the reviewers what you need and why.
privacy.staffNote: Only the owner and admins can make privacy requests.
